description: Capability for the main window. App-defined commands (start_capture, stop_capture, status, open_privacy_pane, start_login, auth_status, sign_out) are auto-allowed for local origins because no app ACL manifest is declared (see tauri-2 webview/mod.rs gate). Frontend IPC needs are limited to listen/unlisten for the 'permission', 'health' and 'auth' events, the opener plugin (open_privacy_pane + start_login open URLs), the autostart plugin, and the deep-link plugin used to receive the gilb://auth/callback redirect.
